methods.cagr: (end / start) ** (1 / years) - 1, only when both ends are positive
methods.cash_conversion: sum(ocf) / sum(net_income) over the last 5 years
methods.debt: debt_total, else debt_noncurrent + debt_current; plus short_borrowings. Excludes lease liabilities.
methods.fcf: ocf - capex (capex = cash paid for PP&E; leases and acquisitions not deducted)
methods.reporting_currency: the currency with the most annual-form money facts; other currencies are ignored
methods.roic: operating_income * (1 - tax rate) / average(equity + debt - cash); tax rate = income_tax / pretax clipped to [0, 0.35], 0.21 if unavailable. Not meaningful for banks/insurers.
methods.share_change_cagr: CAGR of diluted share count (negative = net buybacks)
methods.taxonomy: us-gaap or ifrs-full, whichever has the most recent annual revenue/OCF/net income; ties go to us-gaap. IFRS: net income = profit attributable to owners of the parent; debt = borrowings.
